diffs.diff: pin count: part has 5 (RX_VCC RX_GND RX_SIG EM_VCC EM_GND), datasheet reading has 3 (Red (VCC) Black (GND) White (signal))
diffs.evidence: Product 2167 is a pair of two separate parts. The Adafruit guide says: 'The receiver is on the left, it has three wires. The transmitter is on the right, it has two wires', and 'power the transmitter. Connect the black wire to ground and the red wire directly to 3.3V or 5V power'. The second reading listed only the 3 receiver wires and left out the emitter's red and black wires. That gives 5 connections in total: RX red/black/white plus EM red/black.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: Technical Details on the Adafruit product 2167 page: 'Power Voltage: 3.3 - 5.5VDC; Emitter Current Draw: 10mA @ 3.3V, 20mA @ 5V'. The 5 V in the second reading comes from the guide's wording '3.3V or 5V' (example supplies), not from a stated maximum.
